brand_identity.name: Compass
brand_identity.subtitle: Your Marketplace Assistant
core_principles: Evocative over Literal: Inspired by a compass, but not a direct mapping. It guides without being a map.
Handcrafted Trust: Use warm tones, canvas, and charcoal. Avoid cold Silicon Valley tech hues.
Scalable Simplicity: Must read perfectly at 16px for widget badges, headers, and favicons.

color_palette.primary: var(--ink) - Used for primary text and mono-color icons
color_palette.accent: var(--brand) - Copper/Orange for active states, hover effects, and the primary brand mark
color_palette.rules: No blue tech gradients. Ensure 4.5:1 text contrast minimum.

typography.sub_brand_lockup: Icon + 'Compass' (tracking-tight, font-medium, var(--ink)) + Sub-brand e.g., 'Discovery' (font-normal, var(--ink-muted))

implementation_instructions: 1. Create the icon component file at /app/frontend/src/components/icons/CompassIcon.js and paste the React SVG content provided in 'assets_to_create'.

3. Apply semantic styling to the widget button: replace legacy cyan/teal colors with 'bg-[var(--surface)] text-[var(--ink)] border border-[var(--line)] hover:text-[var(--brand)] shadow-sm transition-colors'.
4. Ensure the widget trigger button has data-testid='compass-widget-button'.

5. Inside the open widget header, add the sub-brand lockup. E.g.,

Compass Assistant
